title: ABIZ well-known file (/.well-known/abiz.json)
description: The ABIZ 1.1 alternative to the _abiz DNS TXT assertion (SPEC section 3.4). It carries the same v, k, h and p values as the TXT record, one JSON string each. Unknown members are ignored. The tag rules of SPEC sections 3.1.1 to 3.3 and 4.2 still apply and are checked by the reference validator. When a valid DNS assertion exists it takes precedence (section 3.4.4).

v.description: Wire protocol family, as the DNS v tag.

h.description: Record host, as the DNS h tag: hostname with optional path, no URL scheme (SPEC section 3.2).

k.description: Optional business key, as the DNS k tag (SPEC section 4.2.1).

p.description: Required Ed25519 public key, as the DNS p tag: standard base64 of 32 bytes, 44 characters (SPEC section 3.3.2).
